title: Face-selective ventral occipito-temporal responses to fast periodic visual stimulation, SEEG (Jonas et al., 2016) (derivative)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 28 patients with refractory epilepsy during fast periodic visual stimulation, in which natural object images were shown at 6 Hz with faces appearing every fifth image (1.2 Hz) or at random positions in a control condition. This derivative release repackages the authors' Letswave files, low-pass filtered at 30 Hz and segmented into sequences, in BIDS format. The data support mapping face-selective responses across the human ventral occipito-temporal cortex.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded with a 256-channel amplifier at 512 Hz from intracerebral contacts, together with some scalp electrodes. Original Micromed TRC files were imported into Letswave 5, low-pass filtered at 30 Hz (Butterworth, order 4), cropped to sequences from 2 s after onset to about 65 s, and merged per condition. The files were then repackaged as BrainVision with events.tsv.
